requirements.requirement: The system must accept sponsor credibility data fields in the API response payload without causing parsing errors.
The system must map sponsor credibility data from the API response to the frontend data contract defined in EVAL-CT-SPONSOR-ST-001.
The system must pass sponsor credibility data through App.tsx into the MessageBubble rendering pipeline unchanged.
The system must preserve existing clinical trial response fields while adding sponsor credibility data.
The system must ensure that existing trial display flows render successfully when sponsor data is present.
The system must ensure that existing trial display flows render successfully when sponsor data is absent.
The system must handle null or missing sponsor fields in the API response without throwing runtime errors.
The system must ignore unknown or extra sponsor-related fields in the API response without breaking the rendering pipeline.
The system must correctly associate sponsor credibility data with the corresponding clinical trial record in the response.
The system must ensure that sponsor data is available to downstream rendering logic (EVAL-CT-SPONSOR-ST-002 and ST-003) in the expected structure.
The system must not introduce additional API calls to retrieve sponsor data beyond the existing response payload.
The system must maintain response handling performance within existing acceptable thresholds after adding sponsor data.
The system must log a recoverable error when sponsor data is malformed and continue rendering other trial data.
The system must ensure type safety when integrating sponsor data into the frontend state or props structures.
